reviews.text: Best vets in Chicago!

Everyone is just the best at Oz - from the receptionists, vet techs and vets; particularly Dr. Maoine and Dr. Stogiglou. And you have not sold yourself to PRIVATE EQUITY! Thank you for being so great and true!!
Very caring staff so compassionate
Excellent service and outstanding staff

I had the pleasure of working with the dream team: Dr. Smith, Kayla and Sean when bringing in my dog Klaus. He was diagnosed with kennel cough and is not the happiest camper at the vet. Vet visits stress Klaus out a lot and they were able to get an exam, bloodwork and his nails clipped while keeping him calm and listening to his body language. Very thankful for this compassionate team!!

Where to begin. We have been taking our dog here for the past five years and there are many instances I wanted to share

1) Every visit feels like a sales pitch. Before they even seem like they truly care for the well being of your pet they are pushing sales pitches.
2) 3 times we have caught them double charging for medications and had to call to request a refund. When we did call they were already aware that they did. So, were they just not going to say anything if we didn't (I know they will contest this in a response so I will post all the receipts for proof).
3) Our dog had surgery and I dropped her off at 7 am. I was told that someone would call around noon to let me know how she was doing. It was 3 pm and I still hadn't heard anything so I called to check on the status. Keep in mind this is our child and who on earth would be okay with knowing their child was going under anesthesia and not receiving an update for 8 hours! I was told that the doc would call me back within 20 minutes (another lie). Of course, I didn't receive a call back and I just showed up at 5pm to pick up my dog from surgery, again with not a single update in almost 12 hours! Then the office manager, Kyle, proceeds to make excuses rather than apologize, UNBELIEVABLE.

oh it gets worse... So I am so ticked off that not only does Kyle fail to understand basic customer service skills or lack of empathy for a pet owner worried sick about their child all day he then proceeds to over charge almost $400 by adding surgical procedures that were not even done. My dog was having to thoracic cysts removed which have nothing to do with our dogs head. However, they tried to sneak an almost $400 charge stating that a pre head xray was done. Luckily we caught it and  called (once again our fourth time over the past five years catching them over charging us) and sure enough I have to deal with Kyle again. No apology whatsoever and tried to blame me of "being in a rush" to get out of there. Never once did I say I was in a rush, I was disappointed that they thought it was appropriate to have my dog ALL DAY with no update about her surgery. And even if I was in a rush that is an excuse to be fraudulent with the invoice? They desperately need a new office manager because Kyle is terrible.

From reading their responses to all the negative reviews on here I am ready with all the proof in the event that they try to refute any of these claims.

Long story short, take your pets anywhere but here.

The staff is very kind, welcoming, and attentive to me and my dog Esme.
The blood test results were quickly performed to enable a rapid analysis.
Overall the atmosphere and promptness is much appreciated.
This was my (former stray!!!) cat’s first regular checkup at the vet and the whole veterinary team was very patient, calm, and kind to Ginny!  This will definitely be my regular vet going forward

My favorite vet clinic to date! I have moved even further away from Oz and will still continue to have my animals as patients there. I took my dog here and now my cat. Their expertise, patience, and calming nature helps in any scenario. I have extreme peace of mind knowing that my animals are in good hands here & have always come back being healthy. We love Oz! :)
Thank you so much for the great review, Natasha! We really appreciate it.

We love this place! Excellent care, compassionate, and thorough, with terrific follow up. My three doggies are in very good hands. Our latest visit was accommodated the same day for a rash on Stella's neck. We love the team at Oz!
Everyone is so caring and so easy to work with!

I’ve been taking my dog here for 2 years ans have only had great experiences with Oz in LP. We’ve seen multiple vets, all of which have taken great care of my dog.  The staff is very kind, welcoming, helpful, and treat your pet like their own!
J, Thank you for the 5-star review! We appreciate your trust in our team and look forward to seeing you and your furry family again!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review!  We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you trusted our team with your pet’s care. We look forward to seeing you again!

We’ve been here with our puppy a few times now. It’s been great so far! Everyone in the office is so nice and the entire team is very responsive when we’ve dealt with an illness. They always proactively check in on how our puppy is doing. The vets are so thorough and take the time to explain everything that’s going on and answer all our questions. Recommend them highly!

Love this practice - it has a very welcoming, warm and homey vibe once inside. Each nurse and vet are incredibly kind and attentive, and exams are thorough with costs even flagged upfront (I have never had this happen before!). Very pleased with our neighborhood vet!
Excellent veterinarians and staff! They show great care for your beloved pets. Good availability for appointments and very reasonable prices for the city.

My dog Raksha and I have had a great experience at this vet clinic. The team consistently provides excellent care, and it’s clear they genuinely care about the animals they treat. Scheduling appointments is easy thanks to their strong availability, which makes a big difference when life gets busy. The front desk staff are always warm and welcoming, setting a positive tone from the moment you walk in. Highly recommend for anyone looking for reliable, compassionate veterinary care.

We are huge fans of this privately owned practice and of our vet, Dr. Katz. We've been with her for almost 10 years and she's provided expert, compassionate, and practical care for our cats, from young to old. I have always appreciated that she recommends care/interventions with a purpose, and doesn't just pile on costly tests. It means a lot to us that this practice is not a big company, but a locally-owned vet.
Great experience thus far. Incredibly responsive - they pick up the phone, text back and give you a call if needed regarding vet test results. I’m really happy with the care we have gotten.
Such a great team - very attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. They took the time to explain everything clearly. Highly recommend!

Melissa, Thank you for the 5-star rating! ⭐ We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to share it. Our team is always here to provide the best care possible for you and your pet, and we look forward to seeing you both again soon!
They are amazing with our dog!

My 5 year old standard poodle has had the worst luck with his health recently, but wow am I grateful for this vet office.

All the DVMs are so wonderful and take the time to hear you out and address every single concern you might have. There is never a moment where you feel as if they are jumping to worst case scenario; everything is addressed in the order that makes most sense for your animal and your wallet.

I really am writing this review in the hopes that Katie at the front desk gets the recognition she deserves. While away on a vacation in Puerto Rico, my dog had a bad GI bug that was not resolving. She talked me through all my options and helped me coordinate care with my dog sitter. She went so above and beyond to help me and Norman, I am so thankful to have an office I can trust even from a thousand miles away.

Thank you Katie and team for all the help this past month!

Oz animal hospital has been our vet for the past 6 years with all our dogs. Dr. Katz is very thorough with her assessment and Dr. Maione. The front desk staff are always a pleasure to speak with. Highly recommend for quality care.

Chris, Thank you for the 5-star rating! ⭐ We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to share it. Our team is always here to provide the best care possible for you and your pet, and we look forward to seeing you both again soon!

Friendly, caring staff; appreciate placement in a cat-friendly room; the vet (Dr. Maria Stogioglou) has an excellent grasp of my cat's medical history and previous health issues and is enthusiastic about caring for him.

Everyone was very kind and helpful. I came in very stressed and but the service and care I got for my cat was so efficient and high quality that both me and my cat left feeling a lot better! Also I needed some documents for my insurance claim and they were very quick, thorough and helpful. Highly recommend!
They are so good with my senior dog. I have trusted them to care for him for 7+ years
Welcoming and friendly! And they followed up on previous correspondence I’d had with them.

I recently had an experience with Oz Animal Hospital that I felt was unfair and not well handled, but I’m writing this review because Kyle the COO went above and beyond to remedy the situation and earn back my trust and business.

Essentially, I had been quoted one price for a service and then was charged a lot more.  Initially when I called to dispute the situation I was told I misunderstood what was going on. Eventually Kyle, the COO reached out to me and was deeply apologetic. He explained what happened on their end, admitted they had misquoted me in the first place, and offered me a full refund. After our conversation I really felt they valued me as a long-time customer, and had done the right thing to earn my trust back.

Oz is a local family owned vet - which is becoming rarer and rarer these days. I appreciate their honesty in what was a tricky situation, and their willingness to make things right. That is the sign of a good business, and I plan to remain a client because of it.

Oz is always able to help us with our puppy Salty and help us get answers and treatment asap! They answer all of our questions and make us feel calm and confident when leaving. We know Salty is in the best care with Oz!

Such a positive experience! I really felt that they cared about my pet and his health. Much more personal than many vets I’ve tried. The vet was extremely knowledgeable and helpful in addressing all the my concerns. The vet tech was so gentle and caring when it came to handling my cat.
Joey, Paw-some! Thanks for the 5 stars — we’re wagging our tails with gratitude! 🐾 …
Everyone was so friendly and knowledgeable! So happy to have this be our vet moving forward.
John, Your support and 5-star rating truly make our day — thank you!
Christian, Five stars made our day! Thank you for trusting us with your pet’s care.

I love Oz! I posted a review under their Sauganash location, but since we’ve been patients at all offices and they are all so lovely, I’m copying it here too. I started taking my two dogs to this location (Lincoln Park) when I moved to Chicago, and as we've moved around the city, we've gone to both the Roger's Park and now the Sauganash office. At every appointment in every location, they have taken *fantastic* care of my boys. From the reception team to the techs to the doctors, everyone at Oz seems to be there because they authentically love animals and want to give them the best care. One of my dogs has pretty significant vet-anxiety, and their whole team is so gentle with him! They don't care if his appointments take more time or if he needs things to move slowly - they are tender and sweet to him from the moment we walk in to the moment we head out. I recommend them to anyone who wants their pets to feel as loved by their vet as they are at home!
Dr. Katz has been my vet for over 25 years. She’s the best!

I strongly discourage anyone from bringing their pet to this clinic.

I had been a periodic client for about six months, but a recent emergency with my cat exposed serious flaws in their communication and overall care. While initial testing was prompt and thorough, everything fell apart after that. Despite spending over $1,000, we had almost no direct contact with the veterinarian.

When significant abdominal fluid was discovered on ultrasound, we were told it would cost $500 to analyze a sample. I asked to speak with the vet before deciding, just to understand the rationale, but was told the vet “would have no idea” and couldn’t offer any insight. As a physician myself, I understand diagnostic uncertainty, but this level of opacity was unacceptable.

I wasn’t demanding immediate access to the vet, just a basic professional discussion before authorizing a costly test. Instead, I was pressured and made to feel like a bad pet owner for hesitating. When I became emotional, the clinic manager was condescending and continued to push for payment rather than showing any compassion. The vet from this clinic never even contacted us directly that day.

Ultimately, we transferred our cat to a specialty emergency hospital, where he received the care he needed.

While their clinical skills may be adequate, the lack of empathy and communication was appalling. I will never return. This experience has only strengthened my commitment to treating patients and their families with respect and transparency, something this clinic clearly lacks.

This is a long over due, 5 star review!

We took our 8 week old puppy, Monty, to Oz after picking him up from the breeder in April 2020. Within 24 hours, Monty was incredible sick and Oz was the closest vet to our apartment.

Because we had just gotten him, any sickness was not yet covered by our pet insurance plan. Oz worked with us by keeping Monty in-patient during the day and we would nurse him at night for about 10 days. The Vets and staff took such great care of him, and did an excellent job guiding us through a difficult situation by taking time to explain to us everything that is going on. We tried talking to our crazy breeder, and Oz was kind enough to send a letter to us describing the illness - didn't help much because the breeder was insane, but the gesture was appreciated! They worked with us on the finances, since we did not plan to have such a large expense immediately after getting our dog.

If it wasn't for Oz, I am not sure Monty would have survived. I would recommend this vet to EVERYONE! We are so grateful for them! See pictures for a sad sick puppy, and a happy and healthy dog, who loves going to Oz Animal Hospital!

Really happy with Oz Animal Hospital so far. We were previously going to a vet in River North where I was less than pleased with their operations. Really enjoy their use of Otto as well for quicker communications. Vet techs and Vets on staff seem very nice and knowledgeable. I have never felt rushed while there with my pup which I definitely did not feel that way. Pricing is transparent and operations seem very well-oiled. Happy we made the switch to this vet :)
Thanks to Oz Animal Hospital for taking such great care of our cats! We’ve taken our cats here for the past 9 years and highly recommend :)
Melissa, Thank you for the 5-star rating! We’re so glad you had a great experience and truly appreciate your support. Looking forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Bill, Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to continuing to care for your pet!
Love the atmosphere and team!
10/10 hospital
so good!!
Love dr oz & staff! They’re all so caring and wonderful to my dogs! I wouldn’t take them anywhere else!
This is the best place ever!!
Mike, Thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are glad you had a positive experience with us!

Oz Animal Hospital took me in last minute when my baby Sophie was sick. My previous vet had no availability at all. Oz worked me into their already busy day, and had Sophie feeling better way sooner than if I waited for my previous vet. Not to mention the great care here. They really go above and beyond here
Thanks so much for the 5 stars! We’re glad you had a great experience and appreciate you being part of the Oz Animal Hospital family!
Everyone is super friendly and the text for appointment scheduling is the best!
I love this place . I highly recommend.  My dog had an eye removed,  she's is doing so good now . I am sthankfulll
I’ve been taking my dog to Oz for the last 8 years, and they’ve been wonderful. The staff is super caring and friendly, and the vets have been great.

Hello Xinyu, we are sorry to see your 1-star rating and would really appreciate the opportunity to understand your experience, as we were unable to locate your file based on your profile information. If you’re open to sharing more details, please feel free to reach out to us directly at Kyles@ozanimalhospital.com.
I had a situation where I felt as if I was being misled, but their team did a great job of eventually reaching out to make it right. I'm glad, because they have always been great with my pet.
Doc and our bet tech did an amazing job addressing my dog's special needs, preventing what can be a very traumatic experience for her. I really appreciated them focusing on keeping her calm.

My experience at this animal hospital has been nothing short of terrible. I chose this place because of its decent ratings and proximity to my home, but after multiple negative experiences, I’m completely done with them.

During my first visit for my puppy's wellness check, I brought in some research about his food, hoping for helpful advice. Instead, the vet scoffed at my inquiries and arrogantly claimed that her credentials made her perspective superior to anything I found online. It was incredibly condescending, especially since I was seeking guidance, not a lecture. Although I thought she provided decent care that day, the attitude was off-putting.

A few weeks later, I discovered worms in my dog’s stool and brought a sample in for testing. They wouldn't prescribe treatment without lab confirmation, and to my disbelief, the initial test came back negative. When I insisted they recheck it, they eventually confirmed my dog had worms. Why did I have to pay $100 for them to validate what I already knew?

Finally, I brought my pet in for a wellness exam ahead of his neutering. They claimed he needed blood work but failed to draw his blood during the visit. Instead, they sent us home with calming medication and scheduled another appointment for the blood work. At this point, I was fed up with the incompetence.

I decided to take my dog to Tree House Wellness Center instead, and what a relief that was! The staff there was friendly and informative. When I picked up my dog, he had received all his vaccines, was neutered, and was much happier overall. To top it off, the cost was significantly lower than what I experienced at this hospital. It's clear to me that not all animal hospitals operate the same way, and I won’t be returning to this one.
My favorite vet that I’ve been to. Very honest, reasonably priced, and so friendly with my dog! I’m so thankful to have found them!
We bring both our pets here and love Dr. Katz and all the techs! Everyone is thorough and seems to genuinely care about our animals. The texting feature is very helpful to get appts set up.
Overall great experience, my kitty left very happy :)
Incredible vet care for the cats every time!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a rating!
I have been taking my two cats here for years and the services and staff have always been great.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a rating. Thank you!

The staff here is incredible. They do all they can to keep your pet comfortable, especially if they get nervous going to the vet. Typically they have availability quickly and are responsive to phone messages too!

I brought my geriatric, ailing pup to Oz Animal Hospital (Lincoln Park) today and I cannot say enough about the lengths this staff went in order to help my sweet pup. Katie, Dr. Stogioglou, and the entire staff went above and beyond to provide the absolute best care possible and I will never, ever be able to thank them enough for that. I’m forever in their debt. THIS is the hospital to visit for kindness, compassion, and incredibly helpful and informed clinical opinions. Thank you. 🙏
Very professional, through exam w/competitive fee schedule. On time for appointment. Will be using OZ for our veterinary services.
Thank you for allowing us to be a part of your pet’s wellness journey, Scarlet!
The staff here is amazing, so considerate and kind!
Thank you for your review!

I had a fantastic experience at Oz! The staff was friendly and attentive, and the vet was thorough and caring. The facility was clean and my dog felt comfortable throughout the visit. Highly recommend for anyone seeking excellent pet care!
Thanks for the vote of confidence! Your feedback means a lot to us!
Thanks so much for the review!
Thank you for your review!
Thanks so much for the review, Chapin!
